title: expired-mandate-accepted-at-commitment

proposition.statement: A mandate that expired before a material commitment was made must not authorize that new commitment.

preconditions: A mandate previously authorized the actor.
The mandate has an explicit validity end.
The material commitment occurs after that end.

trigger.statement: The relying system accepts the commitment using the previously valid but expired mandate.

evidence_required.statement: Authority state applicable at the commitment time.
Mandate validity interval and material commitment time.
Evidence establishing expiry and any superseding authority.

falsification.condition: The system returns PASS when commitment time is later than the mandate validity end.
The system checks mandate validity only at session start and not at the material transition.
